42103.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of pada
42103.meaning1: (of recitation) line by line; word by word

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anupasampannaṃ padaso dhammaṃ vāceyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yañ'ca padaṃ, yañ'ca anupadaṃ, yañ'ca anvakkharaṃ, yañ'ca anubyañjanaṃ, sabbam'etaṃ padaso nāma.

42104.meaning1: rule about (teaching) the Dhamma line by line; Pācittiya 4

examples.text: sikhī, bhikkhave, bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho'ti-ādīsu'pi iminā'va nayena padavaṇṇanā veditabbā.
atha brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇaṃ āha, kuhiṃ so puriso'ti. imasmiṃ ṭhāne tiṭṭhāhī'ti naṃ avacaṃ, kuhiṃ nu kho so gato'ti ito c'ito olokento padacetiyaṃ disvā ayam'assa padavalañjo'ti āha.

42107.meaning1: (gram) parsing of words; breaking up of compound words
42107.commentary: (SNt) atha vā padāni ca padavibhāgo ca padavibhāgo. padaviggaho ca padavibhāgo ca padavibhāgo'ti vā ek'asesavasena padapadaviggahā padavibhāgasaddena vuttā'ti veditabbaṃ. tattha padaviggaho jetassa vanaṃ jetavanan'ti-ādinā samāsapadesu daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: himavā pabbatarājā bibbohanaṃ [bibbohanaṃ, bimba + ohanaṃ = iti padavibhāgo] ahosi

yaṃ pan'etaṃ, evaṃ me sutan'tiādikaṃ nidānaṃ, tattha evan'ti nipātapadaṃ. me'tiādīni nāmapadāni. sāvatthiyaṃ viharatī'ti ettha vī'ti upasaggapadaṃ, haratī'ti ākhyātapadan'ti iminā tāva nayena padavibhāgo veditabbo.

yaṃ pan'etaṃ, evaṃ me sutan'tiādikaṃ nidānaṃ, tattha evan'ti nipātapadaṃ. me'tiādīni nāmapadāni. sāvatthiyaṃ viharatī'ti ettha vī'ti upasaggapadaṃ, haratī'ti ākhyātapadan'ti iminā tāva nayena padavibhāgo veditabbo.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇā, cattāro purisā catuddisā ṭhitā paramena javena ca samannāgatā paramena ca padavītihārena.

42110.meaning1: exerts oneself; strives; applies oneself; perseveres (with)
42110.notes: ussahati denotes the initial effort, padahati denotes a sustained, persevering effort.

examples.text: appaṭivānī sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, padahāmi, kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu, sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ, yaṃ taṃ purisathāmena purisavīriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā vīriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāvāyāmo.
yoniso manasikāro, dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno, n'atth'añño evaṃ bahukāro, uttam'atthassa pattiyā, yoniso padahaṃ bhikkhu, khayaṃ dukkhassa pāpuṇe'ti.

42118.meaning1: to be applied; to be striven for; to be devoted to

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, gahapati, sabbaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabban'ti vadāmi, na pan'āhaṃ, gahapati, sabbaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabban'ti vadāmi
ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, ātappan'ti vīriyaṃ. tadeva padahitabbato padhānaṃ. anuyuñjitabbato anuyogo.

42120.meaning1: having made an effort; having exerted oneself; having applied oneself

examples.text: saddho so, bhante, ariyasāvako evaṃ padahitvā padahitvā evaṃ saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evaṃ pajānitvā pajānitvā evaṃ abhisaddahati.

42122.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pada
42122.commentary: (VIN 2.5.1.4) padaṃ nāma ekato paṭṭhapetvā ekato osāpenti. (VINa) padan'ti eko gāthāpādo adhippeto.

examples.text: padaso nāma padaṃ, anupadaṃ, anvakkharaṃ, anubyañjanaṃ.

42123.meaning1: should be given; should be presented; should be offered (to)

examples.text: tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajjitabbo, yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo, ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

42128.meaning1: following closely in the footsteps of

pada + anupada + ika + aṃ
padānupadika + aṃ

examples.text: buddhā ca nāma pad'ānupadikaṃ vicarantenā'pi saṭhena ārādhetuṃ na sakkā

examples.text: satta vassāni bhagavantaṃ, anubandhiṃ padāpadaṃ, otāraṃ n'ādhigacchissaṃ, sambuddhassa satīmato.
padālatāya antarahitāya sannipatiṃsu. sannipatitvā anutthuniṃsu ahu vata no, ahāyi vata no padālatā'ti

42133.meaning1: splits open; cracks apart; cleaves; bursts open

examples.text: kadā nu nāgo'va asaṅgacārī, padālaye kāmaguṇesu chandaṃ, nibbajjayaṃ sabbasubhaṃ nimittaṃ, jhāne yuto taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

42134.meaning1: routed; rent; torn apart; smashed; broken to pieces

examples.text: upadhī te samatikkantā, āsavā te padālitā, sīho'si anupādāno, pahīnabhayabheravo.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mahato kāyassa padāletā hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mahantaṃ avijjākkhandhaṃ padāletā. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mahato kāyassa padāletā hoti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
seyyathā'pi, sāḷha, yodh'ājīvo mahato kāyassa padāletā, evam'evaṃ kho, sāḷha, ariyasāvako sammāvimutti hoti. sammāvimutti, sāḷha, ariyasāvako mahantaṃ avijjākkhandhaṃ padāletī'ti.
sā taṃ sālaṃ anuparihareyya. sā taṃ sālaṃ anupariharitvā upari viṭabhiṃ kareyya. upari viṭabhiṃ karitvā oghanaṃ janeyya. oghanaṃ janetvā ye tassa sālassa mahantā mahantā khandhā te padāleyya.

42137.meaning1: having broken through; having cracked open; having split through

examples.text: yo nu kho tesaṃ kukkuṭacchāpakānaṃ paṭhamataraṃ pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyya

42142.meaning2: having cleaved, having split, having burst open

42145.meaning1: having lines of verse; so many lines long

examples.text: atha kho rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto yāvatikā nāgassa bhūmi nāgena gantvā, nāgā paccorohitvā, padiko'va yena maṇḍalamāḷassa dvāraṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā jīvakaṃ komārabhaccaṃ etadavoca, kahaṃ pana, samma jīvaka, bhagavā'ti?

42149.commentary: (SNa) ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagatan'ti pamāṇena aṭṭh'aṅgulamattaṃ dvīsu ṭhānesu ādittaṃ majjhe gūthamakkhitaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, chav'ālātaṃ ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ, n'eva gāme kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati, n'āraññe kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati.

42150.synonym: āditta, ādittaka, jalanta, jalamāna, jalita, jhāpenta, jhāyanta, jhāyamāna, sampajjalita

examples.text: gandhatelappadittena, dīpena tamadhaṃsinā, tilokadīpaṃ sambuddhaṃ, pūjayāmi tamonudaṃ.
sehi dārehi asantuṭṭho, vesiyāsu padissati, dussati paradāresu, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
sārambhaṃ nāma kipillikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, upacikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, undurānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, ahīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, vicchikānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, satapadīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, hatthīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti
appamāṇo buddho, appamāṇo dhammo, appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni. ahivicchikā satapadī, uṇṇanābhī sarabū mūsikā, katā me rakkhā katā me parittā, paṭikkamantu bhūtāni.
ko nu hāso kim'ānando, niccaṃ pajjalite sati, andhakārena onaddhā, padīpaṃ na gavesatha.
khīṇaṃ purāṇaṃ nava n'atthi sambhavaṃ, virattacitt'āyatike bhavasmiṃ, te khīṇabījā avirūḷhichandā, nibbanti dhīrā yath'āyaṃ padīpo, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
sabbo ādīpito loko, sabbo loko padīpito, sabbo pajjalito loko, sabbo loko pakampito.
padīpo ca, padīpujjalanaṃ kataṃ kiṃ? padīpujjalanaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

sā na dātā hoti samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyy'āvasathapadīpeyyaṃ.

42167.meaning2: lighted a lamp, explained, made keen

42168.meaningLit: discourse on the simile of the lamp

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃva vahato padaṃ.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā byāpannacittā paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, byāpannacittapaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
byāpannacitto hoti paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo, ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesun'ti.
aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo tathāgatassa paduṭṭhacitto lohitaṃ uppādeyya. n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
te ativelaṃ aññam'aññaṃ upanijjhāyantā aññam'aññamhi cittāni padūsenti. te aññam'aññaṃ paduṭṭhacittā kilantakāyā kilantacittā. te devā tamhā kāyā cavanti.

42175.meaning1: with malevolent intention; with bad purpose in mind; with evil designs
42175.commentary: (MNa) paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappā'ti paduṭṭhacittasaṅkappā, abhadrakena paresaṃ anatthajanakena cittasaṅkappena samannāgatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: byāpannacitto hoti paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo, ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesun'ti

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā byāpannacittā paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, byāpannacittapaduṭṭhamanasaṅkappasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

42180.meaning1: lotus; (specifically) pink lotus; (comm) lotus with more than one hundred petals; (or) white lotus
42180.commentary: (ANa) ettha ca setarattanīlesu yaṃkiñci uppalam'eva, ūnakasatapattaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ, satapattaṃ padumaṃ. pattaniyamaṃ vā vinā'pi setaṃ padumaṃ, rattaṃ puṇḍarīkan'ti ayam'ettha vinicchayo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakaṃpoṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti
udabindu yathā'pi pokkhare, padume vāri yathā na limpati, evaṃ muni n'opalimpati, yadidaṃ diṭṭhasutaṃ mutesu vā.

42181.meaning1: (comm) part of the Avīci hell where one must stay a paduma-count in duration
42181.commentary: (SNa) padumaṃ nirayan'ti pāṭiyekko padumanirayo nāma n'atthi, avīcimahānirayamhi'y'eva pana padumagaṇanāya paccitabbe ekasmiṃ ṭhāne nibbatti.

examples.text: atha kho kokāliko bhikkhu ten'eva ābādhena kālam'akāsi. kālaṅ'kato ca kokāliko bhikkhu padumaṃ nirayaṃ upapajji sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā.

42184.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: jeto jayanto padumo uppalo ca, padum'uttaro rakkhito pabbato ca, mānatthaddho sobhito vītarāgo, kaṇho ca buddho suvimuttacitto.

42185.meaning1: wild Himalayan cherry tree; sour cherry tree; Prunus cerasoides

examples.text: āyantu bhonto ye tattha khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannā, sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontu.

42188.meaning2: heart of a lotus flower; inside of a lotus

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yo evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ padumapattānaṃ vā palāsapattānaṃ vā māluvapattānaṃ vā puṭaṃ karitvā udakaṃ vā tālapattaṃ vā āharissāmī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati

seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakaṃpoṇe padumapalāse udakaphusitāni pavattanti, na saṇṭhanti, evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti
vajjiputto ca vesālī, sajjhāyena ayoniso, majjhanhikālamhi pākat'indriya, padumapupphena cuddasa bhave'ti.

daharo kira ākāsena gacchanto girigāmavāsikammāradhītāya pañcahi kumārīhi saddhiṃ padumasaraṃ gantvā nhatvā padumāni ca pilandhitvā madhurassarena gāyantiyā saddaṃ sutvā kāmarāgena viddho visesā parihāyitvā anayabyasanaṃ pāpuṇi.

seyyathā'pi, ānanda, īsakaṃpoṇe paduminipatte udakaphusitāni pavattanti, na saṇṭhanti, evam'eva kho, ānanda, yassa kassaci evaṃsīghaṃ evaṃtuvaṭaṃ evaṃappakasirena uppannaṃ manāpaṃ uppannaṃ amanāpaṃ uppannaṃ manāp'āmanāpaṃ nirujjhati, upekkhā saṇṭhāti

42196.commentary: (PYt) uppalāni asmiṃ gacche'ti uppalinī. padumāni asmiṃ gacche'ti paduminī, ino, itthiliṅgajotako ī.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā

42199.commentary: (BVa) nāradabuddhassa sāsanaṃ navutivassasahassāni pavattitvā antaradhāyi. so ca kappo vinassittha. tato paraṃ kappānaṃ asaṅkhyeyyaṃ buddhā loke na uppajjiṃsu. buddhasuñño vigatabuddhāloko ahosi. tato kappesu ca asaṅkhyeyyesu vītivattesu ito kappasatasahassamatthake ekasmiṃ kappe eko vijitamāro ohitabhāro merusāro asaṃsāro sattasāro sabbalok'uttaro padum'uttaro nāma buddho loke udapādi.

examples.text: padum'uttarassa bhagavato, paṭhame dhammadesane, koṭisatasahassānaṃ, dhamm'ābhisamayo ahu.
